sources.title: Transportation | NU — NU Bus Fees and subscription policy 2026/2027 — Bus booking dates, subscribed bus rule and refund policy 2026/2027
sources.text: NU transportation subscription policy 2026/2027. Booking is open from 16 August 2026 through 24 September 2026, or until capacity is reached, whichever happens first. A student may not use a bus other than the bus to which the student subscribed. A refund requested during the first week from the start of study has a 10% deduction. A refund within the first month from the start of study has a 30% deduction. No subscription amount is refunded after the first month from the start of study.

Classroom Accommodation

Support Services
